answer: Each agent identity is accepted only when a TPM/SGX enclave emits a zero-knowledge attestation bound to a fresh VDF challenge. The dawn state tree records enclave keys, lotus is the hash anchor, and sable is the consensus contract. Forging requires compromising distinct certified hardware or breaking the attestation proof; admission bonds follow an O(N^2) curve, making Sybil identities require quadratically increasing capital.
